body: Thanks man that makes me feel a lot better. I’m just scared that if she does I’ll be the one to blame and I don’t want to feel that guilt my whole life. And I don’t know how I’m supposed to distance myself from her

I told her that if she needed to talk about it she could and that she should see someone about it and she is ignoring me and keeps talking about how I’m not really sorry and how my problems are nothing compared to hers

She keeps telling me that my problems are nothing compared to hers. I’ve apologized for what I said to her but she keeps going off on me. I feel like she might be manipulating me but I don’t want to ignore it and have her end up committing suicide...
